name: How long does framing a small addition usually take?
description: It depends on the size, weather, materials, and structural complexity. A simple addition frames faster than a complex tie-in or second-story build.

mainEntity.name: How long does framing a small addition usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small additions can move quickly once the foundation is ready, but timing depends on weather, material availability, inspection timing, and how much structural tie-in is required. In the Denver metro area, a simple addition may frame faster than a second-story or complex bump-out, which needs more coordination.
